shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Russia is only discussing introducing external management for Auchan and Nestle assets, and no other decisions have been made.

title: Russia Discusses External Management for Auchan and Nestle Assets, Kremlin Says
